page0.text:
Bet the odds are greater than fifty-fifty that she's after me.
What bothers me is how she's acting.
You'd think, based on her personality, that she'd just drag me right out if she had business with me. But waiting around more like a regular, everyday girl?

page1.text:
"...I want to ignore her, but I don't think it wise... I'm scared of what'll happen if I ignore her."
I get up from my seat holding my lunch.
Bracing myself for the interrogation that's sure to come from Gotou and the others later, I make for the hallway.

page2.text:
"Tohsaka. What are you doing here?"
"O-obviously I'm taking a walk! It's natural to go eat lunch during lunch break, right?"

page3.text:
...Tohsaka is acting too suspiciously.
She's restless and doesn't try to make eye contact with me.

page4.text:
"Okay, yeah, that makes sense. Then go find a good spot.
I'll be at the student council room."
I raise my lunch to say goodbye and turn that way.

page5.text:
"H-hey, hold on! You're doing this on purpose, right!?"
"Hm?"
I turn back around.

page6.text:
"Look, Tohsaka. I don't know what happened, but I can't read minds. If you have something to say, out with it."
...
Tohsaka just stares at me, still unable to explain.
...Hmm.
Could this be...?

page7.text:
"Did you forget your lunch money? I won't give you my lunch, but I can lend you some money if you wanna get a sandwich."
"...Ugh, of course not, you jackass!!!"

page8.text:
Tohsaka basically screams.
The hallway goes quiet at once.
After a few seconds, everything resumes as if nothing happened.

page9.text:
...
...I see, I see. They rejected reality to substitute their own.
Theres no way that Rin Tohsaka—the beautiful idol of the second years and model student moreover—would raise her voice in the hallway, let alone say something like "jackass."
So what just happened has been ignored and entirely erased from memory.

page10.text:
"..."
...Lucky.
I wish I could do the same for the past four days or so.

page11.text:
"...So. If it's not lunch money, then what is it?"
"Uh... Y-you're having lunch, right? Then do you want to come with me? I know a much better place than the student council room."

page12.text:
Tohsaka says in a roundabout way, while peering at me from time to time.
...Oh.
Basically, she just wants to talk to me to have a strategy meeting...

page13.text:
Wait.
Is this really the much better place, Tohsaka?
